onebook.frontierhunts.bound: Your %1$s is now part of your Frontier Handbook, your one book. %2$s opens the Handbook, %3$s the Hunter's Journal, %4$s the Expedition journal. All your progress is kept.
onebook.frontierhunts.books.hint: This is your only book. The buttons at the bottom of every page open these too, and Esc brings you back here.
onebook.frontierhunts.book.journal.title: Hunter's Journal
onebook.frontierhunts.book.journal.desc: Your rank and skills, the checklist, species, records, field notes, Licence & Tags and the reserve.
onebook.frontierhunts.book.expedition.de: Mara's campaign, ranger contracts, stores, training, your lodge and the season calendar.
onebook.frontierhunts.book.school.title: Field School
onebook.frontierhunts.book.school.desc: The illustrated lessons: wind, sign, glassing, stalking, the shot, blood trails and field dressing.
onebook.frontierhunts.book.assignments.d: The six Ranger Academy courses and your field assignment.
item.frontierhunts.frontier_handbook.tip: Your one book: the first hour step by step, every recipe, and inside it the Hunter's Journal, the Expedition journal, the Field School and Ranger Assignments.
item.frontierhunts.frontier_handbook.use: Right-click to open, or press H. J opens the journal, N expeditions, K assignments.
guide.frontierhunts.welcome.p2: Your Frontier Handbook is your one book. It shows what to do first, step by step, with every recipe, and holds the Hunter's Journal, the Expedition journal, the Field School and Ranger Assignments. The card in the top-left corner always shows the one next step. Press %s any time to open the Handbook.
onboard.frontierhunts.start.pack: You start with this Handbook, a Field Recurve Bow and 3 arrows. It is the only book you need: everything else you make or earn, and every recipe is in here.
onboard.frontierhunts.step.8.p2: Open the Expedition journal for Mara's campaign (the Expedition button at the bottom of this book, or N): missions across the reserve, contracts and rewards. Your first report counts the biomes you visit.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.report.how: Open the Expedition journal (Expedition button below, or N), visit three biomes and file the report.
guide.frontierhunts.tip.season.body: %s has come. Animals change their habits with the season; check the calendar in the Expedition journal (in your Handbook, or N).
journal.frontierhunts.check.campaign.hin: Complete all nine reports of Mara's campaign in the Expedition journal (in your Handbook, or N).
Complete three timed contracts from the Expedition journal.
journal.frontierhunts.reserve.campaign_d: Mara's campaign is complete. Contracts remain open in the Expedition journal.
journal.frontierhunts.reserve.contract.2: Contract: %s · %s/%s, ready — collect it in the Expedition journal
journal.frontierhunts.reserve.no_contrac: No ranger contract running. Take one in the Expedition journal (N).
expedition.frontierhunts.ui.next.starter: Field bow and arrows, knives, float rod and an expedition board. The survey only starts once you have them.
